contract_snapshot.title: Admin web pages
contract_snapshot.interface: Blueprint `bp` (name 'admin', url_prefix '/admin'), every route admin_required, actor via guards.actor(). GET /admin -> 'admin/dashboard.html' with stats=DashboardService(...).stats(today=date.today().isoformat(), warranty_days=90). GET /admin/assets?q=&status=&type=&location_id=&tag_id=&employee_id=&condition=&sort=&page= -> 'admin/assets.html' with assets (search_assets rows enriched with tags via TagRepository.for_assets), filters dict (the query values), types, statuses, conditions, tags (all), locations (all), employees (active), sort, total, and pagination (50 per page: page, pages). POST /admin/assets/bulk form {ids (comma-separated), action in ('tag','untag','location','invoice','export'), value} -> apply (bulk_tag / update location_id / attach_invoice / CSV download of the selected) then redirect back to /admin/assets with flash. GET /admin/assets/new -> 'admin/asset_form.html' with asset=None, types, conditions, tags, locations, invoices (InvoiceRepository.list_all), next_tag=service.next_asset_tag('notebook'), error=None; POST /admin/assets/new form fields asset_tag (may be empty -> generated), type, brand, model, serial_number, purchase_date, price, notes, location_id, condition, supplier, warranty_until, cost_center, invoice_id, invoice_number, tags (comma-separated names) -> create, flash, redirect to /admin/assets/<id>; AssetValidationError/DuplicateAssetTag -> re-render the form with error (200). GET /admin/assets/<int:id> -> 'admin/asset_detail.html' with asset (service.get: includes tags and invoice), location (dict or None), holder (employee dict or None), open_assignment, handovers (list_for_asset with details), history (assignments with 'employee'), attachments (AttachmentRepository.list_for('asset', id)), employees (active), tags_all, locations_all; unknown -> 404. GET/POST /admin/assets/<int:id>/edit -> form as for new (asset prefilled; tags as comma-separated names). POST /admin/assets/<int:id>/handover {employee_email, note}, /return {note}, /retire, /lost -> as before, Czech flashes, redirect to detail. GET /admin/handovers?status= -> 'admin/handovers.html'. POST /admin/handovers/<int:id>/cancel. GET /admin/employees?q= -> 'admin/employees.html'. GET /admin/employees/<path:email> -> 'admin/employee_detail.html' with employee, overview. GET /admin/audit -> 'admin/audit.html' with entries (list_recent(200)). Services from src/services/factory.py (build_asset_service, build_handover_service, build_dashboard_service) on get_db().

uses.AssetService: src/services/asset_service.py (create/get/update/retire/mark_lost/next_asset_tag/bulk_tag/attach_invoice; attributes assets, tags, locations, invoices)
uses.config constants: src/config.py: ASSET_TYPES, ASSET_STATUSES, ASSET_CONDITIONS, TAG_COLORS, ATTACHMENT_KINDS, ATTACHMENT_OWNERS, ATTACHMENT_ALLOWED_TYPES, HANDOVER_KINDS, HANDOVER_STATUSES
